source01: Create one independent pixel-art game prop: an academy AETHER CRYSTAL DESK LUMINAIRE for a modern magical-industrial civilization circa early 20th century, a compact faceted amber aether crystal suspended inside two symmetrical thin brass arcs, with a porcelain ivory insulating pedestal, restrained brass calibration ring, a small rotary brightness dial on the base. Elegant measured energy engineering, not medieval fantasy, not steam engine, no ordinary lampshade. HD2D tabletop sprite, frontal view with slight top-down view ~35 degrees, full intact symmetrical upright silhouette, bottom centered solid contact foot. Crystal only softly golden lit, NO white blown highlights, NO drawn bloom, NO halo, NO cast shadow outside silhouette. Native sprite design about 28 pixels wide by 42 pixels tall, simple readable pixel clusters, one consistent square macro-pixel lattice across ENTIRE subject, each logical pixel enlarged as perfectly aligned flat square blocks about 20 image pixels wide, every edge lies on this same grid, every outline one logical pixel, no finer subpixel details or mixed resolutions. Limit to about 16 opaque colors (ivory, warm browns, muted brass, gentle amber). Large macro pixels, no antialias, no gradients, no dithering, no noise. Center prop alone on true transparent background with generous empty margin. No text, no UI, no room, no multiple versions, no measurements. Important this is a magnified tiny native sprite, not detailed illustration.

Correction for this independent second source: first design contained 83 logical pixels tall and too many small clusters. Make the WHOLE luminaire only about 40 logical pixels tall and 24 logical pixels wide. Use macro pixel square blocks approximately 32px on the output, all details at that same coarser grid. One single restrained crystal shape, two simple brass arcs, ivory pedestal; radically fewer details. Every square block aligned. No rings made of tiny dots. No inset fine linework. Keep upper and lower mass balanced and compact, not a tall thin tower.
